title: Rear Parking Aid Test-Distance Specifications
introduction:
For vehicles equipped with rear parking aid, I match each test-position label to its row and read the distance from the rear bumper. Positions grouped in a row share the listed distance. Keep the centimetre and inch units attached to their figures.

These labels are addresses in a test layout, not a map by themselves. The table supplies bumper distances, but no position drawing, test-object specification, operating setup or expected warning response. Use it alongside the matching rear parking aid test instructions; these distances alone cannot establish that the system passes or fails.

edits.why: The rear bumper is the stated distance reference. Position labels select the applicable row; their order alone does not establish physical placement around the vehicle.
